scientific_integrity: Uniform perturbation remainder and limiting distribution are proved analytically. The finite-period diagnostics are supportive only; no external/independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer degree b>=2; sine perturbation only; epsilon=tau/sqrt(n) with tau fixed; all fixed points of the nth iterate (nonprimitive included); no CLT convergence rate or broader-perturbation extension. Historical bibliographic priority not independently certified.
title: A critical Gaussian crossover for periodic multipliers of nearly linear expanding circle maps
